resources.string: Keeps the built-in speaker silent, alarms included, while Bluetooth earbuds keep working.

All speaker sounds, alarms included, are silenced. Routing is steered away from the built-in speaker, every stream is held at zero on it, and any app that still plays through it is muted until it leaves.
Only the volume pins are active: every stream is held at zero on the speaker. Start Shizuku to block the routing and mute apps too.
The built-in speaker is free to play. Its previous volumes and ringer mode have been restored.
Pause media when the earbuds drop so nothing plays on the speaker.
Captures audio headed for the speaker into a loopback inside Utils and discards it. Needs Shizuku, and may not work on this build.
Tells Android a wired headset is plugged in while no other output is connected, so nothing is routed to the speaker. Needs Shizuku, and may not work on this build.

While the switch is ON the speaker emits nothing, alarms included (they are muted until you switch OFF). Streams whose lowest level is above zero are covered by muting the apps that play on the speaker; Android system sounds are only covered by the zeroed volumes. This is a software block, so a Buds disconnect may leak a moment of audio. Restart Shizuku after every reboot; until then only the volume fallback runs.
